scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/copy-manifest.mjs
scripts.build:dev: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && EXTENSION_BUILD_TARGET=dev vite build --outDir dist-dev && EXTENSION_BUILD_TARGET=dev node scripts/copy-manifest.mjs dist-dev
scripts.build:prod: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && EXTENSION_BUILD_TARGET=prod vite build --outDir dist-prod && EXTENSION_BUILD_TARGET=prod node scripts/copy-manifest.mjs dist-prod
